treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Cyprus and the Kingdom of Sweden for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income (1988)
eif_quote: Cyprus MLI position Art. 2 list: "Kingdom of Sweden Original 25-10-1988 13-11-1989"; treaty Art. 26(2): "The Convention shall enter into force upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and its provisions shall have effect on income derived on or after the first day of January 1988."
source_title: CY-SE Convention 1988, English text, Cyprus Official Gazette Annex VII No. 2377, 20 January 1989 (gov.cy MoF scan)

rates.quote: (2) However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;

(2) However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed: (b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

(2) However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
(1) Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties.

notes: Art. 10(4): as long as Cyprus does not impose tax at source on dividends, dividends paid by a Cyprus company to a Swedish resident are not subject to Cyprus tax in excess of the tax on the underlying profits (special rule, not modelled). Art. 10(5): Swedish participation exemption for dividends from Cyprus companies (residence-side). Art. 11(3): interest derived by the Government (incl. political subdivisions/local authorities), the Central Bank or any governmental financial institution of the other State exempt at source. Art. 26(2): effective for income derived on or after 1 January 1988 (retroactive). MLI: both CY and SE list the treaty, but Sweden reserved Art. 35(7)(a) and no 35(7)(b) notification for this treaty was found (treaties_merged.json), so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet taken effect -> ppt.applies=false. Cyprus reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely.
